d:
Welcome to another episode of my Oceania Series as I continue my journey to visit every country in the world.
In this episode, I travel to Timor Leste, one of the youngest and least developed countries in Asia. I flew from Australia to Bali and then continued my journey from Bali to Timor Leste, as Bali is one of the main gateways for travelers heading to the country.
I spent around four to five days in the capital city, Dili, exploring the streets, walking around different parts of the city, meeting locals, and experiencing everyday life in a country that very few tourists visit.
